decls.name: ValuationVectorInjective

paper_span.quote: By (4), distinct $\varepsilon$'s give distinct valuation vectors, hence distinct elements $u_\varepsilon$.

decls.rationale: Proves the distinctness step of Proposition 2.2: the valuation vector determines \(\varepsilon\), so distinct \(\varepsilon\) give distinct \(u_\varepsilon\) — which is what makes \(|U|\) as large as the fibre.
